decision.authority: owner d1b9f3c0 / correction7d8d831e; worker w4 first homepage review
decision.rationale: The public UBC Department of Ophthalmology homepage identifies academic training, care and research as its institutional mission, with concrete eye-health research and a Vancouver Downtown Eastside initiative. It is useful official academic content and not Okanagan-exclusive, personal, duplicate or authentication-only.
evidence: https://ophthalmology.med.ubc.ca/ | a3d851c9a25b379c2ada023139667d9458208853a510d547b326701708a89a69 | We are dedicated to shaping the next generation of leaders in ophthalmology, delivering exceptional care, and advancing the frontiers of knowledge and innovation through transformative research

https://ophthalmology.med.ubc.ca/ | a3d851c9a25b379c2ada023139667d9458208853a510d547b326701708a89a69 | A unique initiative in Vancouver’s Downtown Eastside is bringing Indigenous patient partners and UBC experts together to address barriers to eye care.

fallback.rationale: The institutional department supports ophthalmology education and academic work, expressly training the next generation of leaders alongside care and research.
